items.prompt: What is needed before using the stated O(h²)trapezoid bound?

options.text: Any finite list of values, with no function assumptions
options.why: A continuous second derivative bound is part of this result.

options.text: A smaller h alone proves the function is smooth
options.why: A numerical setting cannot supply smoothness.

options.text: A second-derivative bound and valid evaluations
options.why: The theorem and numerical evaluation budget both need contracts.

options.text: An error estimate always equals a rigorous bound
options.why: An estimate need not certify an enclosure.

items.explanation: The derivation requires f∈C²and a second-derivative bound; evaluation/node/summation errors are separate.
